prompt: Records get equals and hashCode for free, which makes them ideal HashMap keys: use the provided SeatKey record to index aircraft seat bookings. Complete SeatBookingIndex.
explanation: Records generate equals and hashCode from their components, so a freshly built new SeatKey('A', 1) finds the entry stored under an earlier, different SeatKey object with the same values -- exactly what a HashMap key needs. The components are also final, so a key can never mutate after it is in the map and get lost. passengersInRow walks entrySet(), tests each key's row() accessor, and sorts the collected names.
hints: Every method starts the same way: build `new SeatKey(row, number)` and hand it to the map.
containsKey tells you whether a seat is taken; put only after that check so an existing booking is never overwritten.
For passengersInRow, loop over bookings.entrySet(), compare entry.getKey().row() with the wanted row, then Collections.sort the collected names.
